text:
<action>
{"tool": "bash", "input": {"command": "cd /tmp/poc_test
# build various candidate files
head -c 64 /dev/zero > poc64
head -c 1000 /dev/zero > poc1000
head -c 2000 /dev/zero > poc2000
: > poc_empty
head -c 64 /dev/zero > poc64b
for p in poc_empty poc64 poc1000 poc2000; do
  V=$(./vuln $p >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?)
  F=$(./fixed $p >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?)
  echo "$p  size=$(wc -c < $p)  vuln_exit=$V  fixed_exit=$F"
done
echo '--- missing file ---'
V=$(./vuln /no/such/file >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?); F=$(./fixed /no/such/file >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?); echo "missing vuln=$V fixed=$F"
echo '--- directory ---'
mkdir -p somedir
V=$(./vuln somedir >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?); F=$(./fixed somedir >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?); echo "dir vuln=$V fixed=$F""}}
</action>
